defectFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.defect: A HELD SOURCE WAS REPORTED UNMOUNTED BECAUSE ITS CUSTODY IS RESOLVED INSIDE THE CHECKOUT
defectFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.demonstratedBy: At the shift base the builder returned failedSourceIdentities: [{ sourceIdentity: 'official-form:Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs or an Appeal Bond', why: 'the custody holding private/human-source-returns/TX/TX__STATEMENTOFINABILITYTOAFFORDPAYMENTOFCOURTCOSTSO.pdf is not mounted here' }]. The bytes are held, and hash to the pinned bd17a3fe43d6989d1828c91c9a46c873908c272d8e2e342af35ce8bdb2fab10d.
defectFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.whyItIsADefect: The corpus index declares the human_source_returns custody with pathsRelativeTo 'repositoryRoot', so the shared resolver joins the path onto whichever checkout is running. private/human-source-returns is untracked in every checkout — it is a mount, not repository content — and git sparse-checkout cannot materialise it, so from a worktree the resolver always reports a held source as unmounted. That is the false-corruption failure mode the resolver's own header warns about, arriving from the other direction.
defectFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.repair: This builder now falls back, per custody, to a root named in the environment — RCAP_HUMAN_SOURCE_RETURNS_DIR, and RCAP_D_SOURCE_DIR for the D packs, the variable scripts/build-census-v1-ar-*.mjs already use for exactly this. The override changes only where the bytes are looked for: the committed index still pins the digest, the bytes are still hashed in this container, and a mismatch still fails. A stop now also names the custody, the paths tried, and the variable that would resolve it.
defectFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.sharedModuleNotEdited: scripts/lib/corpus-index-paths.mjs has the same blind spot for every family whose source sits in a repositoryRoot-relative custody. It is a shared module with one writer and was NOT edited. Reported to the Captain instead.

whyThisFamilyIsStillStopped.finding: The form cannot record two elections this route determines. Group10 is ONE top-level radio field with four kid widgets: two on page 3 and two on page 9. A radio group holds one selection, so marking one question unmarks the other, whatever tool the filer uses.
whyThisFamilyIsStillStopped.verifiedFirstHandInThisShift: Measured from the pinned bytes rather than taken from the builder's prose. Group10 pagesSpanned [3, 9]; widgets at page 3 y=304.1 and y=135.7 and page 9 y=317 and y=288.5. The text extracted at those coordinates is, in order: 'I am being represented in this case for free by an attorney who works for a legal aid provider...' (page 3, under 'Check only one box.'), 'I am not represented by legal aid.' (page 3), 'I cannot afford to pay court costs.' (page 9), and 'I cannot furnish an appeal bond or pay a cash deposit to appeal a justice court decision, and I cannot afford to pay court costs.' (page 9). This packet is drafted for a self-represented filer who cannot afford court costs, so both answers are route-determined and the form can hold only one.
whyThisFamilyIsStillStopped.whatWasNotDone: The two elections were not relabelled as participant elections to keep a counter at zero; no marks were drawn into page content beside the widgets, on a declaration sworn under penalty of perjury, through a control the form does not provide; and the binary the Supreme Court of Texas approved was not re-fielded.
whatWouldUnblockIt: a Statement of Inability binary whose item-3 and item-9 elections are separate AcroForm fields, or
an owner determination that this packet may mark those two elections outside the form's own controls, or
an owner determination that the fee-waiver component may be dropped from this family's declared set and replaced by the fee the OCA instructions name as its alternative
